name: Gulf Capital
secondary_evidence: Official portfolio describes strategic and majority-stake acquisitions; seller/founder proceeds and a minority-secondary mandate are not established.
ticket_evidence: No current comparable ticket range established; portfolio transaction sizes are not a typical cheque.
fit_hypothesis: Regional growth and cross-border operating support could pair founder liquidity with a GCC expansion plan.
risks: Confirm software appetite, size, legal domicile and ownership preferences; portfolio acquisition history does not prove founder-secondary acceptance.

name: Investcorp
category: Technology private equity — group / ITP route
secondary_evidence: ITP states controlling investments with founders retaining equity. Acquisition of existing ownership is relevant, but the Circularo proceeds split is unconfirmed.
ticket_evidence: Published ITP equity range USD 20–100m; targets about USD 10m+ revenue and positive EBITDA. These are fund criteria, not a Circularo valuation or an offered ticket.
fit_hypothesis: Technology operating partners and international expansion capabilities could support enterprise trust software.
risks: ITP expressly targets European-headquartered companies and control. Resolve the eligible legal entity, operating geography and founder independence before contact.

name: Fajr Capital
secondary_evidence: Official overview records a sizeable minority BIBD acquisition and the Aster investment; no Circularo founder-secondary mandate established.
ticket_evidence: No current software ticket range established; the large Aster investment is a precedent, not a minimum or typical ticket.
fit_hypothesis: Institutional GCC relationships and patient operating support are possible strategic benefits.
risks: Software-sector appetite and practical transaction scale are unverified; evaluate values and investment-policy fit.

name: Al Nowais Investments
secondary_evidence: Official principal-investments page confirms a holding/investment route; no verified software founder-secondary precedent.
ticket_evidence: No public ticket floor, range or current Circularo allocation established.
fit_hypothesis: An operating sponsor within the group could create enterprise distribution and technology adoption.
risks: Holding-company interest cannot be inferred from a technology business listing. Establish the actual investment committee and sponsor.

name: e&
secondary_evidence: Bespin precedent is explicitly primary minority investment plus a majority regional JV. It does not demonstrate founder-secondary willingness.
ticket_evidence: USD 60m initial primary commitment in the 2022 Bespin transaction; single precedent, not a typical or minimum ticket.
fit_hypothesis: A direct corporate-development investment could combine GCC enterprise channels with Circularo's management-reported digital-trust position.
risks: Founder liquidity must be agreed independently of a commercial alliance. Validate existing DigiSign relationship, exclusivity and IP/roadmap boundaries.

name: G42
secondary_evidence: Official CPX acquisition supports corporate acquisition activity; it does not establish a minority founder-secondary mandate.
ticket_evidence: No comparable transaction cheque established; do not infer willingness from group size.
fit_hypothesis: Potential sovereign trust infrastructure alongside cloud, AI and cybersecurity offerings.
risks: Require a real group operating sponsor and approved secondary structure. Agentic trusted execution is Circularo's draft future direction, not verified production.

name: stc Group
secondary_evidence: 2024 reporting records operating acquisitions and a 40% Devoteam Middle East stake. Founder proceeds and Circularo secondary eligibility remain unknown.
ticket_evidence: No current comparable cheque range established.
fit_hypothesis: solutions/sirar and group enterprise routes could support Saudi distribution, digital trust and cross-border adoption.
risks: Use group corporate development and an operating sponsor; Tali Ventures is excluded from this batch. Verify localisation, channel overlap and group approval authority.

name: Elm
secondary_evidence: Official indexed announcement describes full Thiqah acquisition; the full page remained inaccessible. Minority-secondary appetite is unknown.
ticket_evidence: No current comparable ticket range established.
fit_hypothesis: Saudi public-sector workflows and trusted transaction infrastructure could create strategic value.
risks: Direct portfolio overlap and preference for integration/control. Require a structure and operating boundaries compatible with founder objectives.
key_people: Mohammad bin Abdulaziz Alomair; Alameen Alhazmi

name: Five Elms Capital
secondary_evidence: Current materials support flexible software growth investment; a specific founder-secondary policy was not established by the pages checked.
ticket_evidence: Fund V announced USD 5–75m in 2021. Current Fund VI range is not disclosed in its checked announcement; requalify rather than treat the old range as current.
fit_hypothesis: Hands-on software operations, international go-to-market and product support could provide business value beyond capital.
risks: Current AI-forward focus and software growth expectations need to match documented Circularo metrics. Confirm founder liquidity, eligible domicile and current cheque size.

name: Level Equity
secondary_evidence: Current site explicitly offers minority growth capital and majority growth equity/recaps. The founder-secondary amount and terms remain unconfirmed.
ticket_evidence: Current cheque range not established; older one-pager criteria are historical and require requalification.
fit_hypothesis: Operational value creation and B2B software portfolio relationships could help distribution and international growth.
risks: Do not use structured-credit investments as equity evidence. Reconfirm ARR/growth gates, GCC legal-entity eligibility and proceeds allocation.

name: Spectrum Equity
secondary_evidence: Published strategy explicitly includes shareholder liquidity and minority recapitalisations.

fit_hypothesis: Software/data expertise and go-to-market support could help scale an enterprise trust platform.
risks: Company scale, revenue quality, eligible domicile and appetite for GCC concentration must be tested before detailed outreach.

name: FTV Capital / Ascend

fit_hypothesis: Enterprise technology, financial-services network and published human/AI control-layer thesis could support a digital-trust expansion case.
risks: Requires a meaningfully larger transaction than the user's floor and proven business fundamentals. Pure secondary versus mixed capital remains a gate.

name: Entrust

ticket_evidence: No comparable cheque range established.
fit_hypothesis: Identity assurance, signing and sovereign deployment could form a broader trusted-transaction proposition.
risks: Significant direct overlap and possible full-acquisition preference. Protect IP, customer relationships and product independence.

name: OneSpan

ticket_evidence: No comparable cheque range established.
fit_hypothesis: Digital agreement and cybersecurity channels could value Circularo's management-reported sovereign GCC position.
risks: Direct signing competition, integration priorities and acquisition preference; require a specific complementary market mechanism.

name: DigiCert
secondary_evidence: Vercara acquisition demonstrates strategic M&A; no minority founder-secondary mandate established.

ticket_evidence: No comparable cheque range established.

name: Volpi Capital
secondary_evidence: Official Version 1 transaction describes a management buyout; current approach supports B2B software/tech services. Founder-secondary terms for Circularo are unknown.
ticket_evidence: EUR 90m equity in the 2017 Version 1 transaction; a dated precedent, not a current minimum or typical ticket.
fit_hypothesis: Published channel/alliance, sales and international expansion support could help Circularo enter Europe and the US.
risks: European platform/geography and profitable-growth requirements must be qualified. Clarify control preference and founder rollover expectations.

name: Main Capital Partners
secondary_evidence: Current site publishes majority-stake acquisitions. Signicat's Inverid announcement identifies Main as seller and reinvesting minority shareholder.
ticket_evidence: No current equity ticket range established by checked pages.
fit_hypothesis: Security/identity, government and business-transformation software ecosystem could provide buy-and-build and distribution synergies.
risks: Targets northwestern Europe and North America; GCC entity eligibility is uncertain. Main's minority position in Signicat links these routes; do not count them as wholly independent pools.

name: Inflexion — Enterprise / Partnership Capital
secondary_evidence: Official flexible-capital strategy explicitly allows shareholder realisations, with dedicated minority Partnership Capital and minority/majority Enterprise investments.
ticket_evidence: 2023 Enterprise commentary cites GBP 10–75m; treat as dated. 2024 Partnership Capital III targets enterprise values GBP 200m to over GBP 1bn, not equity tickets.
fit_hypothesis: International expansion, commercial effectiveness and technology support could add operational value.
risks: UK/northern-Europe scope and company-scale gates may be restrictive. Choose the eligible strategy; never convert enterprise value into an equity cheque.

name: Keensight Capital
secondary_evidence: Current official approach explicitly includes liquidity to existing shareholders and minority or majority investments.
ticket_evidence: Current site states portfolio-company revenues EUR 10–400m; this is a revenue criterion, not ticket size. Current cheque range unestablished.
fit_hypothesis: Technology operating support, internationalisation and security-adjacent experience could support Circularo expansion.
risks: Need evidence of qualifying profitable growth, revenue scale and European eligibility; no approved Circularo numbers establish those gates.

name: Signicat
secondary_evidence: Inverid acquisition from Main and founders, with selling shareholders reinvesting, is direct seller-liquidity/rollover evidence. It remains an acquisition, not a Circularo minority-only precedent.

fit_hypothesis: European identity distribution plus a GCC trusted-transaction expansion could be strategically complementary.
risks: Nordic Capital-backed consolidation, portfolio overlap and control expectations. Main is a minority shareholder following the Inverid deal; overlapping routes require coordination.

risks: Direct competition and integration workload. Prior FAQ/company-history chronology discrepancy remains unresolved; use year-level wording and do not infer production readiness.
